name: White-stone mango
summary: The mango from the garden of Chùa Từ Quang, once sent to the royal court and so also called xoài Ngự. A local proverb pairs it with the cassava of Phường Lụa: “Xoài Đá Trắng, sắn phường Lụa”.
origin: Phu Yen. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam’s article on Chùa Từ Quang names xoài Đá Trắng.
culture: The fruit went to the court, which is why it is also called xoài Ngự.
where: The garden at Chùa Từ Quang, in xã An Dân, huyện Tuy An, about 35 km north of the city and about 500 m from QL1A.
seoTitle: Xoai Da Trang — the mango at Chua Tu Quang
seoDescription: The court mango of Chua Tu Quang, also called xoai Ngu, about 35 km north of Tuy Hoa.
